repair_summary: Added import-only/testable helpers for probability_by_label, stable example_id, and read-only manifest metadata lookup by clip_id.

Future validation/test sidecar rows now include stable example_id, split, manifest_path, manifest_sha256, manifest_row_index, tensor_path, tensor_sha256, tensor_hash_source, source/review/crop metadata already present in manifests, probability_by_label, and true_label_probability.

Future negative-challenge rows now include stable example_id, split, manifest path/hash, manifest row index, tensor path/hash, probability_by_label, and true_label_probability set to null because reject rows have no true class.
Observer nudge 627 follow-up keeps negative-challenge record tensor_path as the JSON-safe project-relative sidecar string and stores the internal tensor loader Path under _tensor_path.

Future prediction sidecars now include a sidecar_contract block with version, row identity fields, manifest/tensor fields, score fields, field provenance, logits_by_label set to not_included, and pretrained_components as an empty list.
Future validation reports generated with --prediction-sidecar now include a prediction_sidecar reference with sidecar path, schema version, and contract version before the report is written.
